# tina4ruby

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

TINA4: The Intelligent Native Application 4ramework for Ruby. A zero-dependency backend with its own HTTP server, native Ruby conventions and shared cross-language contracts.

## 官网

- 主页: https://tina4.com
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/tina4ruby
